title: Complex to Magnitude-Angle
text: Compute magnitude and/or phase angle of complex signal, 1 input, 2 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Output} sets Magnitude and/or phase; {Approximation method}, {Number of iterations} and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_2
ports.summary: Radian phase angle scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Output
params.values: Magnitude and/or phase angle output specification Magnitude and angle (default) | Magnitude | Angle

params.name: Number of iterations
params.values: Number of iterations for CORDIC algorithm 11 (default) | positive integer, less than or equal to word length of fixed-point input
